caption:
A KID IN A BASEMENT SHOULD BE ABLE TO REPLICATE IT.

No paywalled journals. No proprietary cluster. No $50,000 instrument.

The 6.40-sigma directional signal — and the night it died. The data is on Zenodo and MAST — free. The code is on GitHub — free. The scripts run on any laptop with Python and astropy — free. Run it yourself and watch the offset collapse from 5.4σ to 0.3σ as you tighten the threshold.

That's not a limitation. That's the standard. If your result needs a supercomputer and a subscription to verify, it's not science — it's marketing.

Every null result, every falsified hypothesis, every dead end: published. The scripts that failed are right next to the scripts that worked. Same directory. No shame.

Gatekeeper-bypass isn't about being cheap. It's about being undeniable. When anyone can rerun your work, your work has to be real.
